## Summary

- Localize 62 Electron-visible throw/dialog messages through desktopT; electron baseline 146 → 84.
- Guard generated pre-push hooks when the optional Ponytail runner is absent, with schema-v3 root-cause coverage.
- Add manual check:handoff branch health report with optional full-suite failure count and three focused unit tests.

## Validation

- pnpm run typecheck
- pnpm run check:i18n
- pnpm run check:ponytail-review
- pnpm run check:root-cause-contracts
- pnpm run check:gates-chain
- pnpm run check:filesize
- pnpm run check:heavy-path
- pnpm run check:boundaries
- pnpm run check:test-waits
- pnpm run check:quality-gate-workflow
- pnpm run check:test-types
- pnpm run test:system:focused
- pnpm run lint:ci
